translations.web: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.
translations.bsb: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
translations.kjv: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
translations.asv: And Judas Iscariot, he that was one of the twelve, went away unto the chief priests, that he might deliver him unto them.
